verdict.rationale: The evidence pack repeatedly cites a public docs page (api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing) as the source for model capability details, confirming a self-service pricing page exists that anyone can view without contacting sales, and community threads reference DeepSeek's low per-token cost as a known factor (e.g. deepseek-comm-5, deepseek-comm-19). However, no citation in the pack actually quotes specific per-token dollar figures for each current model, so we cannot confirm completeness or currency of the published rate table. Missing for 10: explicit per-token price figures for every current model, confirmation the page covers all models (not just legacy ones), and independent verification that displayed prices match real billing.
